lines.t: Before the breath inside my lungs Before my heart learned to run
You chased the lines of who I'd be In it, in light, in mystery
I wandered through what I became, a fractured echo of your name
Dust and fire in my chest, trying to feel what I suppressed
Then you called me out of silence like the dawn splits open night
Every piece of who I was started turning toward the light
You bring me life, from the dirt you form my story
Now your breath is in my fight, yes you are my savior
You knew me from the start, now I'm breathing in your rhythm
Like you're beating in my heart
I was living half a lie
Where in truth I'd falsified
Every mirror showed a ghost
Of the man I needed most
But your voice cut through the blur
Like a wound that had to hurt
Still in here but I deny
Now I feel it deep inside
Every sorrow has a purpose
Every tear has found its place
Was broken in the dark Now it's shining in your grace
You make me whole Every breath a new beginning
Every scar a piece may go Yeah, it was you, my savior
You rewrote all my wrongs Now I'm standing in the freedom
I was searching for so long
You formed me from the dust and pain
Spoke beauty through my shame
Every loss and every scar
Still you loved me as I am
Now I'm held within your hands
Not by force but by your love
Even in my lowest place
You were reaching from above
Now I feel what I was made
Every heartbeat tells a story
Of a life no grave could take
Yeah, who's you? I'm a savior
You're the truth that set me free
Now I'm fully awakened
To the life you breathed in me
I was one, I was none
Not alone, I'm your own Through the dark, through the flame
And now I will never let go
